> window size check in WebContentsBasedCanceller::IsWindowTooSmall() to
> prevent untrusted web popups from spoofing context behind the OS file
> chooser dialog, while exempting trusted browser surfaces (chrome://,
> devtools://, and chrome-extension://) via IsExemptFromWindowSizeCheck().
>

> WebContents (https://gemini.google.com/...) rather than a <webview>
> guest inside chrome://glic. When docked in a narrow side panel (< 400px
> wide) or floating at its minimum width (352px), IsWindowTooSmall()
> measures the PWC's own view size against 400x300 and suppresses file
> pickers (such as window.showOpenFilePicker() via FileSystemChooser and
> <input type=file> via FileSelectHelper).
>
> Since WebContents created with PrivilegedParams
> (outermost->IsPrivileged()) are trusted browser-owned surfaces just
> like WebUI and extension surfaces, exempt them in
> IsExemptFromSizeCheck() alongside IsExemptFromWindowSizeCheck().

[M157] [omnibox] Don't blur the omnibox when handing off focus to Full WebUI

Original change's description:
> [omnibox] Don't blur the omnibox when handing off focus to Full WebUI
>
> Typing in a new window's omnibox before the Full WebUI popup was ready
> blurred the omnibox once the popup became ready, about a second after
> the window opened.
>
> Until the popup is ready, the native `OmniboxViewViews` textfield holds
> focus. `LocationBarView::OnFullWebUiOmniboxReady()` then hands focus to
> WebUI by moving Views focus to `LocationBarView`. The popup is still
> closed at that point, so `OmniboxViewViews::OnBlur()` took its regular
> blur path: it stopped autocomplete and cleared the results, killed the
> edit model's focus, and collapsed the selection to a caret. Only then
> did `LocationBarView::OnFocus()` refocus the omnibox in WebUI.
>
> - `OmniboxViewViews::OnBlur()` returns early when focus moves to
>   `LocationBarView` in Full WebUI mode, which only happens during this
>   handoff. The edit model keeps its focus, draft, and autocomplete
>   results, and `LocationBarView::OnFocus()` hands the native selection
>   to WebUI unchanged. The early return still tail-elides the native
>   text, resets its scroll position, and clears its accessibility label,
>   since the textfield never gets `OnBlur()` again once it can't take
>   focus. The elision and scroll reset moves into a new
>   `ElideAndResetScrollPosition()` that both paths call.
> - Remove the selection save and restore around `SetFocusedView()` in
>   `OnFullWebUiOmniboxReady()`. It only undid the collapse in `OnBlur()`,
>   which no longer happens there.
> - Add `FullWebUIOmniboxInteractiveTest` tests for the handoff and for a
>   real blur. The handoff test fails without the `OnBlur()` change: the
>   results are cleared and WebUI gets a caret instead of the selection.
>   The blur test clicks the page while the native textfield has focus,
>   and fails if the early return covers more than the handoff.
>

> [ContextualTasks] Fix blank side panel zero state

> `#composebox` is hidden during subsequent zero-state navigations.
